provenance.source: NCERT Mathematics Class 8, Chapter 1 'Rational Numbers' — distributivity of multiplication over addition and subtraction. The misconceptions are the recurring ones: forgetting the second term, distributing over multiplication, and sign errors when distributing a negative.
provenance.note: m1 (multiplying only the first term) is a hand-movement error rather than a belief — a student writes the first product and their pen moves on. It is still worth a distractor, because it is by far the most common wrong answer here and the correction is a habit ('do arrows, not one') rather than an explanation.

concepts.title: Distributivity of multiplication over addition
concepts.statement: Kisi rational number ko do numbers ke jod se guna karna, aur alag-alag guna karke jodna — dono ka jawab ek hi aata hai: $a \times (b + c) = a \times b + a \times c$. Ghatane pe bhi yahi chalta hai.
concepts.hook: Socho tumhe 6 doston ke liye samosa lena hai. Har dost ko 2 samose aur 3 kachori. Ab do tareeke hain — pehle ek dost ka poora hisaab (2+3=5) karke 6 se guna karo, ya 6 doston ke samose (6×2) aur 6 doston ki kachori (6×3) alag-alag ginkar jodo. Dono me 30 aayega. Sawal ye hai: kya ye hamesha kaam karega, ya sirf is baar sanyog se?

analogies.text: Class ki 4 rows, har row me 5 ladke aur 3 ladkiyan. Total = 4×(5+3), ya 4×5 + 4×3 — jaise bhi gino, 32.
Ek din 2 ghante maths aur 1 ghanta science. 5 din me kitna? 5×(2+1) = 5×2 + 5×1 = 15 ghante.

formulas.latex: a \times (b + c) = a \times b + a \times c
formulas.note: Distributive law. 'a' DONO se guna hota hai.

formulas.latex: a \times (b - c) = a \times b - a \times c
formulas.note: Ghatane pe bhi wahi — sign ka dhyan rakho.

formulas.latex: a \times b + a \times c = a \times (b + c)
formulas.note: Ulta bhi chalta hai — common number bahar nikal lo. Isse hisaab aasan ho jaata hai.

misconceptions.wrong_belief: $a \times (b + c) = a \times b + c$ — sirf pehle wale se guna karo.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Bracket ke andar dono cheezein hain, aur bahar wala number dono pe lagta hai. Sirf pehle se guna karne pa doosri cheez guna hone se reh jaati hai.
misconceptions.correction: Do teer chalte hain, ek nahi. Bahar wala number bracket ke ANDAR ki har cheez se guna hota hai.
misconceptions.probe: $3 \times (4 + 5)$ — pehle bracket solve karke nikalo, phir distributive law se. Dono ka jawab same aaya?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: Distributive law guna pe bhi chalta hai: $a \times (b \times c) = a \times b \times a \times c$.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Distributivity guna ka JOD pe hota hai, guna pe nahi. $2 \times (3 \times 4) = 24$ hai, par $2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 4 = 48$ — dugna ho gaya, kyunki 2 do baar laga diya.
misconceptions.correction: Bracket me PLUS ya MINUS ho tabhi distribute karo. Guna ho to seedha guna kar do.
misconceptions.probe: $2 \times (3 \times 4)$ ko dono tareeke se karo. Kya same aaya?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: $a \times (b - c) = a \times b + a \times c$ — distribute karte waqt minus plus ban jaata hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Bracket ke andar ka sign waisa ka waisa rehta hai. Minus tha to minus hi rahega.
misconceptions.correction: Sign bracket ke andar se aata hai — badalta nahi. $5 \times (4 - 1) = 20 - 5 = 15$.
misconceptions.probe: $5 \times (4 - 1)$ pehle bracket se, phir distribute karke. Doosre me tumne plus lagaya ya minus?

misconceptions.wrong_belief: $-a \times (b + c) = -a \times b + a \times c$ — negative sirf pehle term pe lagta hai.
misconceptions.why_wrong: Bahar wala poora number, sign ke saath, dono se guna hota hai. Negative number distribute karo to dono term negative honge.
misconceptions.correction: Sign bhi number ka hissa hai. $-2 \times (3 + 4) = -6 + (-8) = -14$.
misconceptions.probe: $-2 \times (3 + 4)$ ka jawab kya hai? Ab distribute karke dekho — dono term ka sign kya nikla?

worked_examples.problem: $\frac{2}{5} \times \left(\frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{4}\right)$ ko dono tareeke se hal karo.
steps: Dono se $\frac{2}{5}$ — distributive law kaam kar gaya

worked_examples.problem: Distributive law se hisaab aasan karo: $\frac{7}{9} \times \frac{5}{6} + \frac{7}{9} \times \frac{1}{6}$
steps: Dono me $\frac{7}{9}$ common hai — usko bahar nikalo
Bahar wala number $-\frac{3}{4}$ hai — sign uska hissa hai

questions.stem: $3 \times (4 + 5)$ ko distributive law se kaise likhenge?
questions.solution: Bahar wala 3 bracket ke andar ki DONO cheezon se guna hota hai: $3 \times 4 + 3 \times 5 = 12 + 15 = 27$. Check: $3 \times 9 = 27$ ✓
Bracket se: $5 \times 3 = 15$. Distribute karke: $5 \times 4 - 5 \times 1 = 20 - 5 = 15$. Dhyan do — minus distribute karne par minus hi rehta hai.
Bahar wala number $-2$ hai, sign uska hissa hai. $-2 \times 3 + (-2) \times 4 = -6 + (-8) = -14$. Check: $-2 \times 7 = -14$ ✓

questions.stem: In me se kaunsa kathan GALAT hai?
questions.solution: Distributivity guna ka JOD (ya ghatav) pe hoti hai, guna pe nahi. $2 \times (3 \times 4) = 24$ hai, jabki $2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 4 = 48$ — 2 do baar lag gaya. Baaki teeno sahi hain.

questions.stem: $\frac{7}{9} \times \frac{5}{6} + \frac{7}{9} \times \frac{1}{6}$ ka maan kya hai? (dashamlav me char sthaan tak)
questions.solution: Dono me $\frac{7}{9}$ common hai. Bahar nikalo: $\frac{7}{9} \times \left(\frac{5}{6} + \frac{1}{6}\right) = \frac{7}{9} \times 1 = \frac{7}{9} \approx 0.7778$.

questions.stem: Sneha ne likha: $\frac{1}{2} \times \left(\frac{3}{5} + \frac{2}{5}\right) = \frac{3}{10} + \frac{2}{5}$. Galti kahan hai?

options.text: Usne $\frac{1}{2}$ ko sirf pehle term se guna kiya, doosre se nahi
Usne plus ki jagah minus lagana tha
Distributive law yahan chalti hi nahi

questions.solution: Sahi hota $\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{3}{5} + \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{2}{5} = \frac{3}{10} + \frac{2}{10} = \frac{5}{10} = \frac{1}{2}$. Sneha ne doosre term ko $\frac{1}{2}$ se guna karna bhool gayi.

questions.stem: Distributive law istemaal karke jaldi nikalo: $\frac{4}{7} \times \frac{9}{11} + \frac{4}{7} \times \frac{2}{11}$. Jawab dashamlav me char sthaan tak.
questions.solution: $\frac{4}{7}$ common hai: $\frac{4}{7} \times \left(\frac{9}{11} + \frac{2}{11}\right) = \frac{4}{7} \times \frac{11}{11} = \frac{4}{7} \approx 0.5714$. Alag-alag guna karke jodne me zyada mehnat lagti.

questions.stem: Samjhao ki distributive law se hisaab kaise aasan ho jaata hai. Ek udaharan do jahan ulta istemaal (common number bahar nikalna) chhota raasta ho.

rubric: Distributive law dono taraf chalti hai — todna aur jodna
Ek udaharan diya jahan common factor bahar nikalne se bracket ka jod aasan ho gaya
Dikhaya ki seedha guna karne me zyada steps lagte
Nateeja: jab do guna me ek number common ho, use bahar nikal lo

questions.solution: $\frac{7}{9} \times \frac{5}{6} + \frac{7}{9} \times \frac{1}{6}$ seedha karne me do guna aur ek jod lagega, aur beech me bade numbers aayenge. Par $\frac{7}{9}$ dono me common hai, to use bahar nikal do: $\frac{7}{9} \times \left(\frac{5}{6} + \frac{1}{6}\right)$. Bracket ka jawab $1$ aa gaya, to poora hisaab $\frac{7}{9}$ ho gaya — ek line me. Yahi baat aage algebra me bhi kaam aayegi, jahan isko 'common factor nikalna' kehte hain.
